identity.title: MGraphDTA: deep multiscale graph neural network for explainable drug–target binding affinity prediction

eligibility.scope: Prior published model transferred to the newly authorized NC2099 affinity benchmark

execution_scope.objective: PPIKB noncanonical peptide–protein Kd benchmark with standard-residue controls; stratified non-natural/PTM evaluation
execution_scope.authorization_reference: Latest direct user instruction: PPIKB 2099 noncanonical Kd candidates, standard controls, separate non-natural and PTM evaluation, strict splits, independent external validation, at least five predecessor papers, all ten seeds, no novel model.
execution_scope.relation_to_prior_run: New direct-user-authorized scientific target: common NC2099 plus standard-residue controls, not a continuation or deadline reset of legacy3354/11250/legacy62 runs. Root must attach matching historic task/run IDs once registered. Existing expired clocks/restrictions remain intact. This DOI-derived stable ID is proposed for a separate new benchmark batch; root must link duplicate historical identities without changing old62 expiry/status.
excluded_claims: No claim to reproduce original paper tables on the changed dataset
No PepLand or PepLand-derived binding input

restriction_check.reason: This scoped benchmark excludes PepLand, Twin Peaks, previously denied primary-source unit investigations, sequence design/optimization and metadata-only train exclusions. Old restricted work is not restarted.

timing.clock_notes: 15:59:53Z is first persisted campaign clock as provided by leader; early skill reading may precede this. Conservative hard cutoff01:45Z applies to all papers/panels/seeds. prior_window_expired=false describes the newly authorized scope only; no historical expired task is revived.

numerical_policy.determinism: Torch seeds and deterministic_algorithms(warn_only=True); exact CUDA bit determinism not claimed; MGraphDTA adaptive max pool nondeterminism warning retained
numerical_policy.notes: Generic WSL GPU route is separate from restricted workflows; GPU canary does not establish full-fit feasibility or equality with Node23. Actual policy/launch snapshot pending.

resources.start_gate: Pending final root live GPU process/profile gate: at most1 physical GPU, at most3 owned concurrent processes only if profiled feasible; per-fit CPU2/RSS4GiB/GPUallocated3GiB
resources.budget_basis: Pre-fit throughput-driven revision from Node23 CPU plan; no validation/test metric consulted; current route canary verifies original four retained methods, GS-DTA adapter/GPU gate still pending

execution.seed_policy: One model-fit seed per run; frozen split and all hyperparameter-search candidates retained; seeds 0–9 all reported

process_control.mechanism: Pending actual root launch/run_unit.py and process-group supervisor

stop_conditions: 出现平台拒绝或缺少适用授权

training_regime.selection: lowest validation MAE by epoch and LR; ties lower candidate index
training_regime.holdout_scope: all retained test records, mutually exclusive chemistry strata plus608 annotation-discordance sensitivity flags; score only after selection frozen
